neural_fedlc: extensions/fedlc/plan.json: paired controls, 12 runs, 21.6M backward examples each; development only
ple: 9 runs: central PLE, compressed PLE, raw wide compressed control at each seed. Reuse historical PLE16, architecture, rates, samples, 21.6M backward examples. Central PLE seed17/27 fills missing matched representation controls; no tuning.
trees: 9 runs: central, cyclic, cyclic FedLC. Frozen depth6,200 boosting rounds,10x20 client visits, cosine eta .05 to .015, sqrt weights. Central uses same final tree capacity and schedule, but 100M row-visits versus 5M cyclic. Not compute matched to one another or neural nets.
payload: Neural encoded message bytes; tree historical cached-tree estimate AND full-model UBJSON uplink/downlink sum. Neither is measured network traffic. Full-model path more closely describes serial model handoff. No latency ranking from differing barriers.
evaluation: Same 500k fit rows, development calibration/audit and per-seed 5% target. Report all targets and class metrics. Existing PLE and FedLC-tree confirmation endpoints replayed with frozen models/thresholds only. No newly trained control or neural FedLC is scored on confirmation.
limits: Retrospective within-collection study, one client partition, different historical tuning effort. PLE bins and global class weights use pooled fit information. No privacy or external generalization claim.
